title: Jobetus and Cass McCord, the supposed twins
summary: Holmes replaced Jobetus McCord, doubting he and Cass were really twins, and Joe Garland took Cass's chair.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I replaced Jobetus, who was Cass McCord's brother..
Yes, but Jobetus was Ted McCord.
I don't know what Jobetus' name was.
That's all I know, if Jobetus. How they become twin brothers I don't know, because one was named Cass McCord and the other was named Jobetus.
Well, as I understand it, Jobetus' real name was Ted McCord... [THEODORE JOBETUS MCCORD]
I don't know what his real name.
...and he was a fraternal twin of Cass McCord. Isn't that correct.
I don't know. All I know, they're supposed to be twins, but they looked like twins just like me and you look like and twins.
Well, fraternal twins don't have to look alike.

They didn't look alike. They didn't talk alike. They didn't anything alike. In fact, I had my doubts that they was brothers. I mean, there was nothing to resemble them -- except that they were brothers. And I liked both of them. Both of them were good musicians. But I didn't see no twins, where they were twins.
But that's beside the point. Anyway, I had taken Ted...
Jobetus' place. And shortly after I went in the band, then Cass, he quit the band, too, and Joe Garland taken Cass McCord's place. Then they started
calling themselves the Blue Rhythm Band.
